value.name: checks diversion list
value.description: Asha opens a second tab and searches the county's emergency mental health diversion list while working through the form.
evidence: She opened a second tab without closing the first, typed in the search string for the county's emergency mental health diversion list, and was halfway through the form

value.name: receives Rosa's urgent text
value.description: Asha's phone buzzes with Rosa's message telling her that blank means diversion and to clear the table before the kids hear.
evidence: the phone buzzed against the table: Rosa, one line, telling her that blank meant diversion, to check it now, and then to clear the table before the kids heard her

value.name: realizes diversion is possible
value.description: Claire notices the word diversion on the screen and stops hoping the search will come back empty.
evidence: Claire's eyes moved to the screen at the word diversion and stayed there a moment longer this time
she had stopped waiting for the search to come back empty in the way she had been hoping it would

value.name: tension in the house deepens
value.description: The quiet house takes on a heavier, more urgent feel as the situation shifts from waiting to counting minutes.
evidence: Above them the house was still quiet, but the quiet had a different weight now, the kind that counted minutes rather than held them

value.name: hides notes from Claire
value.description: Asha turns the phone face down, moves the legal pad out of Claire's view, and keeps typing.
evidence: Asha turned the phone face down, slid the legal pad over the edge of the screen where Claire could not read what she was writing, and kept typing

value.name: submits diversion form
value.description: Asha submits the diversion form and records the confirmation number on the legal pad without letting Claire see it.
evidence: Asha tapped Submit on the diversion form and watched the confirmation field replace the empty one, a string of letters and a case-tracking number she copied onto the legal pad without letting Claire see the angle of her pen

value.name: calls psychiatric admissions
value.description: Asha picks up the phone and dials the county hospital's psychiatric admissions extension from Rosa's texts.
evidence: Then she slid the pad under the edge of her elbow, picked up the phone, and thumbed through to the county hospital's main line, scrolling past the public-facing menu to the direct extension for psychiatric admissions that Rosa had sent her two texts ago

value.name: Claire's hands go still
value.description: Claire's hands separate in her lap and one settles flat on the table, signaling her growing strain.
evidence: Claire's hands had come apart in her lap; one of them was resting flat on the table now, fingers spread
